caption: When presented the opportunity, you should always side quest. This is not technically a @jeep_and_ginger first in terms of the building, but it’s definitely the first visit to @sassybritchesbrewing. With 14 options on tap, their flight of 13 is perfect.  Increase seating since our visit to the previous incarnation, there’s never a wrong time to stop in at a woman led brewery! #CraftBeer #BrewsCruiser #DrinkLocal #WomanLed #JeepLife

You might assume that you have no reason to stop in Mallorytown when you’re heading down the 401. But then you’d totally miss out on the opportunity to stop into @arbrubeer. This is Canada’s first Solar Powered brewery but don’t let that fool you, when it comes to vibe, taste and pizza, they put pedal to the metal. Their offerings include a non alcoholic beer which is nice, and their April featured pizza is beef taco (hello? Did you KNOW it’s my birthday?!?). Absolutely make a point of taking a break in Mallorytown. #jeep #jeepwrangler #jeeplife #jeepandginger #roadtrip #drinklocal #brewscruise #brewscruiser

Stop 3 brought Thelma to @blueelephantinc. Literally the best flight board in ever. A deceptive place from the outside, this is the kind of place you expect someone to yell “NORM”. Definitely worth checking out, the nostalgia is like a warm hug #BrewsCruiser #CraftBeer #DrinkLocal #JeepLife

@pubbrewskey has been a #bucketlist #craftbrewery for a while. We finally had occasion to stop in today. Fantastic place with excellent beers. The Imperial Stout P-Nut Buster both pleased my soul and broke my heart at the same time. Not available canned but a beer I will remember for a long time. #jeep #jeepandginger #jeepwrangler #jeeplife #craftbeer #drinklocal #supportcanada #mtlmoments #brewscruise #brewscruiser

#jeepandginger answer the bell! Fighting on behalf of labour makes one thirsty so a stop into @bellwoodsbeer was just what we needed.
